        try:

                return int(decimal.Decimal(num_s).quantize(decimal.Decimal('1'), rounding=decimal.ROUND_HALF_UP))
        except Exception:
            return s
        return s
    
    if isinstance(v, (int, float, decimal.Decimal)) and not isinstance(v, bool):
